evidence_items.claim: Lloyds participated in UK FCA/Bank of England Digital Regulatory Reporting (DRR) Pilot Phase 1 and 2 (2018-2019) using ISDA CDM 2.0
evidence_items.excerpt: In 2018 and 2019, the 2 UK regulators collaborated with 7 banks to complete 2 pilots. The banks were Barclays, Credit Suisse, HSBC, Lloyds, Nationwide, NatWest and Santander.
evidence_items.caveats: Pilot from 2018-2019 (5+ years old). Phase 2 identified gaps but no continued evidence.

null_results.implication: Not listed as FINOS CDM contributor
No recent CDM activity since 2019 pilot
